# gitmoap_users (Data Source)

List the members of a group, with their profiles. Returns the profiles of the people who are direct members of the group named by `group_id`, a page at a time (at most 100). Only a signed-in member of that group may list them.

The token needs `user:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_users" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group whose members to list (required)

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
